name: shader-lens-blur
title: Shader Lens Blur
blurb: WebGL shader animation with geometric shapes responding to mouse and touch.
description: Renders GPU-accelerated geometric shapes (rectangle, circle, or polygon) using Three.js shaders. Shapes animate continuously with gradient colors and respond to pointer position.
use_when: A dramatic, performance-heavy effect requiring GPU acceleration and full pointer/touch interaction.
avoid_when: On low-end devices or in hierarchies where WebGL context management could conflict.
a11y: Purely visual and interactive via pointer only. No keyboard interaction; interaction is decorative.
